about: West Grey is a municipality in Grey County, Ontario, covering Durham, Neustadt, Ayton, and surrounding countryside—not a single city. Saugeen River towns, farm roads, and a rural Grey County landscape sit inland from Lake Huron toward Hanover and Flesherton. About 13,000 people live in West Grey.
